title: Iran attacks US bases in Middle East after reports US strike killed five at wedding party
description: The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and it never targets civilians.

title: Chris Mason: Will Burnham find PMQs as 'nail biting' and 'nerve wracking' as Blair did?
description: Curiously, the questions at lunchtime may well feel like a minor extension of what he faced on Tuesday, the BBC's political editor writes.

title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty as judge clears way for death penalty trial
description: The  23-year-old is charged with aggravated murder, a capital offence in Utah, and six other counts.

title: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
description: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

title: Children as young as six going to A&E in mental health crisis
description: NHS emergency departments are seeing more cases of self-harm, eating disorders and emotional distress in young people.

title: Ariana Grande makes emotional tour exit and steps back from public life
description: The star makes an emotional farewell as she wraps up a tour she's described as her "last hurrah".

title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
description: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

title: US aircraft carrier docks near Thai beach resort Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
description: The USS Abraham Lincoln is docking close to Pattaya, known for its raucous nightlife, and for sex tourism.

title: Fake 10 Downing Street listing exposes 'unfit' Booking.com, says consumer group
description: Booking.com said the "limited test" was "not a true reflection of the experience of millions of listings or reviews".
